glosses.notes: Usually used for delivering goods or supplies to a home, shop, or other destination.

examples.sentence: 公司说今天下午会把电脑配送到家。
搬新家那天，我们让公司直接配送床和桌子。
爷爷住院以后，药店每天都会配送药过去。

example_translations.translation: The company said it would deliver the computer to my home this afternoon.
On the day we moved, we had the company deliver the bed and table directly.
After Grandpa was hospitalized, the pharmacy delivered medicine to the hospital every day.

glosses.notes: Noun for an open container used for water, washing, plants, or other things placed inside.

examples.sentence: 洗完菜以后，她把水倒进旁边的大盆里。
阳台上那盆花几天没浇水，叶子都软了。
医生让他先把脚放进那盆热水里。

example_translations.translation: After washing the vegetables, she poured the water into the big basin beside her.
That potted flower on the balcony hasn't been watered for days, and all its leaves have gone limp.
The doctor told him to put his feet into that basin of hot water first.

glosses.notes: Usually means to hit or touch something, often by accident. In warnings, it can simply mean not to touch.

examples.sentence: 他下楼的时候，碰到了门口的椅子。
这个杯子太薄，你轻轻一碰就会碎。
你先别碰那个杯子，水还很热。

example_translations.translation: While going downstairs, he bumped into the chair by the doorway.
This cup is so thin that it will shatter if you touch it lightly.
Don't touch that cup yet; the water is still very hot.

glosses.notes: Verb for unexpectedly meeting someone in ordinary daily situations.

examples.sentence: 我刚出地铁站，就碰见了以前的老师。
她在路上碰见妈妈，才知道家里来客人了。
我们只想买面包，却碰见了正在找我们的朋友。

example_translations.translation: I had just come out of the subway station when I ran into one of my former teachers.
She ran into her mother on the way and only then learned that guests had come to the house.
We only wanted to buy bread, but we ran into the friend who was looking for us.

glosses.notes: Measure word for people, goods, or items dealt with in the same group or shipment.

examples.sentence: 这批苹果今天早上刚从南方运到市场。
第一批游客已经上车了，大家再等十分钟。
老师说那批桌子明天上午送到学校。

example_translations.translation: This batch of apples was just shipped to the market from the south this morning.
The first group of tourists has already boarded the bus; everyone else wait another ten minutes.
The teacher said that batch of desks would be delivered to the school tomorrow morning.

glosses.notes: Commonly means to criticize or scold. In school contexts it can mean to mark written work, and in formal contexts it can mean to approve.

examples.sentence: 因为我又迟到了，经理开会时当面批了我。
老师把我们的作业都批了。
领导已经把这个计划批了，我们明天就做。

example_translations.translation: Because I was late again, the manager criticized me to my face during the meeting.
The teacher marked all of our homework.
The leadership has already approved this plan, so we'll start on it tomorrow.

glosses.notes: Formal verb for giving official permission or agreeing to a plan, request, or decision.

examples.sentence: 经理批准了我的假，我下周可以回家。
这个项目昨天终于被学校批准了。
没有家长批准，孩子不能自己报名。

example_translations.translation: The manager approved my leave, so I can go home next week.
This project was finally approved by the school yesterday.
Without a parent's approval, a child can't sign up alone.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for horses; bolt of cloth
glosses.notes: Measure word used mainly for horses and similar animals, and also for whole lengths of cloth.

examples.sentence: 那匹老马看见主人来了，就慢慢走过来。
奶奶买了一匹蓝布，准备给我做裤子。
草地上那匹白马慢慢走到河边去了。

example_translations.translation: When the old horse saw its owner coming, it slowly walked over.
Grandma bought a bolt of blue cloth and plans to make pants for me.
The white horse on the grass slowly walked to the riverbank.

glosses.notes: Can mean cheating someone out of something or misleading someone with a lie.

examples.sentence: 那个人假装是医生，差点骗走了老人的钱。
你别再骗孩子说打针一点儿也不疼。
他怕妈妈生气，就骗她说作业写完了。

example_translations.translation: That person pretended to be a doctor and almost tricked the old man out of his money.
Stop telling the child that shots don't hurt at all.
He was afraid his mother would get angry, so he lied to her and said the homework was finished.

glosses.notes: Can mean joining things together, spelling a word, or pushing oneself hard to win or finish something.

examples.sentence: 请把这两张小桌子拼在一起，大家才坐得下。
报名时我把自己的姓拼错了，只好重新填表。
比赛只剩最后一分钟，大家决定再拼一次。

example_translations.translation: Please push these two small tables together so everyone can fit.
When signing up, I spelled my own surname wrong, so I had to fill out the form again.
With only the last minute left in the game, everyone decided to make one more all-out effort.
